entities.summary: Luigi Natoli was a Sicilian Roman Catholic priest. He was born in Patti, in north-eastern Sicily. He was ordained on 2 March 1822; was appointed bishop of the Caltagirone on 15 March 1858; and became archbishop of Messina on 22 February 1867. He died on 24 February 1875.
